title: Velocity before magnetic field
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the velocity v = a₁t = (F/m)t, yielding v = 2 m/s.

title: Acceleration upon entry
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration a = (F - BIL)/m, using I = BLv/R, yielding a = 0.2 m/s².

title: Maximum speed
description: Essential: Correctly determines the maximum speed v_m from force balance F = BIL, using I = BLv_m/R, yielding v_m = 2.5 m/s.

title: Pre-entry kinematics
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law (F=ma) to find the constant acceleration before entering the field.

title: EMF and current upon entry
description: Important: Applies Faraday's law (E=BLv) and Ohm's law (I=E/R) to find the induced current at the moment of entry.

title: Force balance at max speed
description: Important: Recognizes that at maximum speed, net force is zero, so the magnetic force (BIL) equals the applied force F.

title: Sign error in magnetic force
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign/direction for the magnetic force in Newton's second law (e.g., F + BIL = ma).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows consistent use of SI units (N, kg, m, s, T, Ω) throughout the calculation.
